text: Stone has successfully plugged & abandoned the VR 131, OCS 00775, Well No. 022ST.  The "11 Upper Sd" perfs were squeezed and cement plugs set.  Operations began on June 22, 2008 and were completed on June 27, 2008.

Stone has successfully drilled and completed for production the MC 109 A28ST1.  The well was spud on 12-23-10, by cutting a window in the 9 5/8" @ 4101' MD / 3573' TVD. The well was drilled to a total depth of on 01-24-11, 14890' MD / 9594' TVD, w/a MW of 12.1 SBM.

A 5" prod. liner was set from 12220' MD to TD,14880' MD and the well completed for production.  The well was completed as a single, gravel packed oil completion in the "M" Sd with perforations of 14438' - 14557' MD.  Operations were completed on the well on 02-25-11.

A correction report has been filed to change the "Well Status" of this well. 

Please note that all the plugs placed in this well were placed by the previous operator in 2000, McMoRan does not have the dates of when the plugs were placed and tested.

McMoRan only performed milling operations, jet cut & pulled 7-5/8" csg @ 579' and set a 10-3/4" CIBP @ 578'.

The ST 86 OCS-00605, Well E-5 was spud on August 27, 2007 and TD'd on September 16, 2007 at depth of 4289' MD / 4113' TVD. The well was completed for production as a single,gravel packed, oil completion in the 3700' Sand with existing perforations of 4084' - 4134' MD. Completion operations began on September 25, 2007 and completed on October 01, 2007.

Sever, pull and remove all casing for permanent abandonment. (Other permanent abadonment operations previously conducted.)

All casing (7", 10-3/4" & 16") cut on 2/19/14 with cutting tool at 20' BML. Total length 74', 6250 lbs.

Cut 16" drive pipe on 2/21/14 to 15' BML. Length 68'- 26,550 lbs.

Remington has drilled the EC 316 OCS-G 23803, Well No. 01 to a TD of 3600' MD /TVD, w/a MW of 10.2 ppg.  The wellbore was TD'd on 04-22-07.  7 5/8" 29.7#/ft, ECP-110 production csg has been set at 3565' MD /TVD.  Remington has performed Inital Completion Opertations of the EC 316 Well No. #001 as a  sub sea (mud line tree installed, single, GP, gas completion in the 3300' Sd.

Stone Energy has completed the drilling and permanent abandonment of the ST 110, OCS-G 26094, Well No. 01. The MODU, Ensco 87 was on location on 01-28-09 and the well was spud 02-05-09.  The well was drilled to a TD of 5375'MD /TVD on 02-13-09.

No commercial quantities of hydrocarbons were discovered and the well was permanently plug and abandoned on 02-19-09, with the rig stacked on location on 02-21-09.

Rooster Petroleum, LLC has successfully completed TA operations of the VR 376 A-2 Well. The 2-7/8" LS tbg was cut/pulled f/ 1,000' BML (1,392' RKB) & the 2-7/8" SS tbg was cut/pulled f/ 990' BML (1,382' RKB). 

Operations began 06/04/2017 and were completed 06/18/2017.

Lower sliding sleeve was closed on 6/26/2017. The well was produced through the upper sliding sleeve for 14 days. The well was shut in on 7/10/2017.  Note: An APM was approved on 7/12/2017 to reopen the lower sleeve and resume down hole commingling.

The subject well is already classified as TA with the TA date 06/06/2009. This EOR is the first phase of the well P&A operation. The second phase will occur in the near future and will address the removal of the casing strings 15' BML, removal of the three pile well protector, and the site clearance survey.

BYPASS GC825-04 ST00BP00 WELLBORE WITH 16.5 X 19-INCH BHA AND DRILL TO 15,858-FT MD / 15,145-FT TVD. INSTALL 16-INCH CASING AT 15,649-FT MD / 14,947-FT TVD. DRILL 14.5 X 17.5-INCH HOLE SECTION AND INSTALL 14-INCH CASING AT 18,704-FT MD / 17,720-FT TVD. DRILL OUT 14-INCH SHOE AND ENCOUNTERED LOSSES AT 19,031-FT MD. CURED LOSSES WITH AN LCM PILL AND DRILLED AHEAD. ENCOUNTERED A SECOND LOSS ZONE AT 21,236-FT MD. UNABLE TO REGAIN FULL RETURNS. PLUGBACK OPEN-HOLE INTERVAL WITH CEMENT AND PREPARE TO BYPASS.

Performed caliper log survey and modified gas list design. New Live GLVs at 3611', 4287', 5120', Orifice valve @ 5915'. Set chemical injection valve at 7348', dummy GLVs at 6712', 7509', 8303' 9097' 9892', 10726'

The EC 316 #2ST wellbore was spud on 09-11-07 and TDd' on 09-17-07 at a depth of 4344' MD / 3278' TVD.  A 7 5/8" 39#/ft, P-110 prod. liner was set from 3834' - 4344' MD. Completion operations of the well began on 09-20-07 and were completed on 10-05-07. The well was completed as a single, gravel packed, gas completion in the Trim A 3300'Sand.

Well will remain in COMPLETED status. 

This operation will be closed out while evaluating a plan forward to TA well due to "Thick gray substance". Once plan has been decided a new permit to TA the well will be submitted.

Hydro plugged and Temporarily abandoned the G14870 No.7 well bore. 
Hydro will cut and remove all remaining casings and drive pipe to a minimum depth of 15' BML when the caisson is removed and the site cleared.

Additional TA work was completed on 03/17/2011.  The 7-5/8" was cut with a casing cutter at 285' BML on 03/07/2011.  From 08/17/09 to 08/18/09, the 26" and 10-3/4" was cut at 14' BML during wedding cake operations on the platform to remove obstructions to the wellbore.

Operations to remediate SCP via zonal isolation were completed on 05/20/2021.  Note that eWell recognizes the well as TA'd due to zonal isolation even though the well is not plugged through the surface plug.

Temporary suspend drilling operations after setting 13.375" surface casing and test to 2,000 psi against dry hole tree.  Will move back on well after drilling and completing West Delta 21, Well No. 9.

After several unsuccessful attempts to shift the sliding sleeve a decision was made to discontinue the current operation; wellbore configuration remains the same. 

Discontiued Opertions on 6/13/2016.

Temporarily isolated the reservoir pressure from the tubing, casing, and leaking gas-lift valve check by installing both a retrievable pump-through plug (DXX) in the profile with a Packoff plug and AA Stop set on top of the DXX plug.
